title: Stock futures flat as U.S. and Canada appear headed for trade war
summary: U.S. stock-index futures remained stable as the country appeared poised to enter a trade war with Canada, a major trading partner. The potential conflict raises concerns about economic impacts on both nations. Investors were monitoring developments as markets opened the trading week.
content: U.S. stock-index futures were little changed on Sunday, as it appeared the U.S. was on the verge of an all-out trade war with Canada, one of its biggest trading partners.

zh.title: 股票期货持平，美国和加拿大似乎走向贸易战
zh.summary: 美国股指期货保持稳定，因为该国似乎准备与主要贸易伙伴加拿大进入贸易战。潜在冲突引发人们对两国经济影响的担忧。投资者在市场开盘交易周时密切监测动向。

title: Oil prices fall as investors await 'toughest' U.S. sanctions on Iran
summary: Oil prices declined Monday as investors awaited details of the U.S. government's announced "toughest-ever" sanctions campaign against Iran. The sanctions are expected to have significant implications for global energy markets. Market participants remain cautious pending official details from Washington.
content: Oil prices fell Monday as investors awaited details of what Washington has billed as its toughest-ever sanctions campaign against Iran.

zh.title: 油价下跌，投资者等待美国对伊朗的最严厉制裁
zh.summary: 周一油价下跌，投资者等待美国政府宣布对伊朗的有史以来最严厉制裁活动的详细信息。这些制裁预计将对全球能源市场产生重大影响。市场参与者对华盛顿的官方细节持谨慎态度。
